caption: The video captures a single female dancer in a long gradient dress—green at the bodice, pink at the waist, green at the hem—with trailing pale sleeves, standing before a full-wall mirror in a brightly lit studio. Behind the mirror's vertical seam, white pleated curtains hang beneath purple and white ceiling spotlights, while a window on the right reveals city buildings beside wooden ballet barres, stacked blue mats, red blocks, and a black speaker. The dancer's head tilts progressively backward as her arms lift and spread outward, drawing the sleeves up beside her face. She then rotates through a side profile until her back faces the camera and she confronts the mirror. Throughout, her reflection tracks each pose in sync. Her raised arms continue small undulating motions while the skirt sways gently. Her position relative to the mirror seam stays essentially fixed as only orientation and limb configuration change.
relations: Head tilting backward and arms lifting outward draw the pale sleeves up beside her face.
Rotating through a side profile until her back faces the camera makes her confront the mirror.
The mirror reflection tracks each pose change in sync as her orientation and limbs shift.
Her position relative to the mirror seam stays fixed while the skirt sways gently.
